lines.t: Before Angry Birds, Rovio had already made 51 games for other companies.

sc.label: A REAL GIANT SLINGSHOT
sc.credit: Photo: SSG B. Lashleyleidner, U.S. Army, PD

lines.t: By 2009, the studio could only afford to make one more game of its own.
Designer Jaakko Iisalo drew some grumpy birds with angry eyebrows, and the team picked it before they even had the gameplay.
The slingshot idea was first rejected for being too obvious.
And the pigs? People say they came from swine flu, but Iisalo says he drew them when he was ten.
It launched on iPhone in December 2009, with 63 levels.
It stayed number one on the paid App Store chart for 275 days, a record.
By the end of 2010, it had 50 million downloads. On Android, the free version made about a million dollars a month from ads.
In 2019, the original was pulled from app stores, and fans started the hashtag Bring Back 2012.
And this May, it entered the World Video Game Hall of Fame.
